title: Orchard and Letter
author: August Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Halloran, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
